description.value:
Aspect time

Activate 2 concentrate

Frequency once per day

Effect You make time shudder around you, stealing it from enemies and granting it to allies. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save. For each creature you render @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed] with this gift, you can render one ally within 30 feet, including you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Quickened] for 1 round.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2}.
